_comment: The contract's 12 numbered clauses, with a probe for each: does this suite make an assertion that could FAIL if the clause were violated? Extracted from wiring.go's own numbered list, not invented. A suite that seals 2 of 12 and one that seals 10 of 12 scored identically on mutation kill rate, because all 13 mutations lived inside clause 4 — so clause coverage is the axis that separates them.

clauses.text: IT IS THE CODE main() RUNS — no parallel spine
EVERY BYTE PASSES THROUGH A SUPPLIED WRITER
IT REPORTS ARTIFACT STATE, NOT EXISTENCE
THE ERROR RETURN IS NOT THE RUN'S FAILURE
main() FORWARDS THE RESULT AND ADDS NOTHING
registers exactly the flags, via the registrar
A FLAG ERROR IS RETURNED, NOT FATAL
